subject: Request: rural AI reading-assistant pilot credits & residency constraints
messages:
From: Dr. Amina Khatri <amina@ruralschools.org>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot credits & residency constraints for rural AI reading assistant

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking a look — I'm Amina, program lead for the Rural Schools Coalition. We're building a lightweight reading-assistant that runs on inexpensive tablets for students in remote districts (K–8). We're a registered 501(c)(3) and the pilot will run across 8 districts (approx. 2,500 students).

The technical ask: we need inferencing credits and, ideally, a trial extension so we can evaluate across a full school term (6 months). Our initial estimate is ~200k tokens/month (inference) for the pilot period. We also have a regulatory constraint: any student data must stay inside the United States — we cannot have cross-border backups or processing.

Can Redwood provide a trial extension and a nonprofit credits package? We are flexible on deployment model but residency matters a lot — if a private or dedicated deployment is required we can explore procurement. Attached is a short pilot overview and a sample usage estimate.

Appreciate any guidance and what the procurement path would look like.

Best,
Amina Khatri
Program Lead, Rural Schools Coalition
amina@ruralschools.org
(attachment: pilot-overview.docx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Amina Khatri <amina@ruralschools.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits & residency constraints for rural AI reading assistant

Hi Amina — thanks for the clear note and the overview. This sounds like exactly the kind of impact-oriented pilot we try to support.

Quick answers up front: we can often extend trials for nonprofits and provide credits for evaluation. Given your residency requirement, there are two routes: (1) Hosted but constrained to our US data region (we'll need DPAs and a data-processing addendum) or (2) Dedicated/Private deployment if you need stronger controls (different cost profile).

Before I ask internal partners for an uplift, could you do two small things:
- Confirm expected monthly token volumes (you mentioned ~200k/month — is that peak or average?)
- Fill out the attached one-page Mutual Action Plan (pilot-MAP-template.xlsx) with rough success metrics and timeline (start date, end date, top 3 acceptance criteria).

As a tentative offer I can put forward: a provisional 5,000 USD credits + a 3-month trial extension while we work through the residency procurement path. If you can confirm usage and sign the MAP, I'll escalate for a nonprofit uplift to cover a larger package.

Looping in Laura (Sales Ops) and Priyom (Nonprofit programs) to help with approvals and the procurement checklist.

Best regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
(attachment: pilot-MAP-template.xlsx)

Marcus / Priyom — reviewed Amina's ask and the pilot overview. Given the nonprofit status and the social-good impact, I'm comfortable approving a larger uplift than Marcus proposed, with conditions.

Decision: approve 10,000 USD credits and a 6-month trial extension conditional on the following:
- Confirmation of US-only data residency (tech contact signs DPA / addendum)
- Execution of a one-page SOW (we'll use the SOW-draft as the base)
- Simple procurement form filled (finance needs a line-item for a nonprofit pilot)

Next steps: Marcus, please send a formal offer to Amina with an SOW draft and the DocuSign for the DPA. Priyom, please prepare the nonprofit credit uplift code and confirm internal chargeback details. I'll note this as EDU-approval-2026-10-06 for tracking.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Hi Amina — great news: we've approved a nonprofit uplift.

Offer summary (approved):
- 10,000 USD in Redwood credits applied to your account
- 6-month trial extension (start date to be confirmed once SOW signed)
- Residency constraint: production inference must run in Redwood's US-only region (we'll provide the DPA / addendum)

Attachments and links: SOW draft attached; sign DPA here: https://www.docusign.com/express/abc123-RSC-SOW; SOW editable here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bSOW-draft

Next steps:
1) Amina — please review and confirm the MAP and the monthly token estimate (so we can size the Dedicated option if needed).
2) We'll schedule a 30-min onboarding call next week to align technical contacts and provisioning. Please share 2 windows that work.
3) Procurement: please provide billing contact and PO cadence if the districts will be issuing a PO.

Once the DPA is signed and the MAP + SOW are in place, Priyom will push the credit uplift and I'll loop in our onboarding team.

Happy to jump on a call if helpful. Congrats — excited to get this pilot going.

Cheers,
